tool: Generic meeting-notes AI (Otter / Fireflies / Granola style)
how: Each recording is summarized on its own and action items are extracted per meeting, with no memory across meetings and no knowledge of your priorities or standing rules.

meetings.summary: Chris recorded a morning voice memo covering priorities for the day. Topics included preparing for Monday's Kestrel board meeting, a dentist appointment that now conflicts with IC on Tuesday, sending the Kestrel bridge wire today, and a few longer-term personal goals such as writing a book and learning to sail.

Maya and Chris reviewed several open items for Northwind Seed. Maya relayed a Friday 2:00 PM meeting request from Arlo Vance at Quarry Labs, an intro request from Nina at Fernhill to Dev at Kestrel, and a fireside chat invitation to the Cascadia Seed Summit on October 15. Chris committed to sending comments on the Fernhill memo by 5:00 PM ahead of Tuesday's IC.

The partners discussed the pipeline (Quarry, Fernhill, Halcyon) and frustrations with the current CRM, including a proposal from Jordan to build an in-house replacement, which Jordan will write up for a possible Q1 review. Priya will run the Halcyon CEO reference call, Fernhill goes to IC Tuesday once Chris's comments are in, and Maya noted that Tidewater received a term sheet that expires in 72 hours with a pro-rata of about $400K.

Dev confirmed the Kestrel bridge documents are signed, and Chris said the wire would go out that afternoon. Dev is considering letting Greg, the sales lead, go before Monday's board meeting because pipeline has been flat for two quarters; Chris asked to review the sales comp plan first. Dev also asked for an intro to Renee Park, COO of Harborline Logistics.

Sam and Chris reviewed a bug where reloading the page mid-session causes the same receipt to fire twice, likely because the fired list is held in client memory and the server replays the last event on socket reconnect. They also discussed switching to OpenAI embeddings for speed, renewing the Apple developer account, and a future Slack integration.

Helen Marsh of Cedar Point Family Office asked for the Q3 LP letter by October 10, ahead of their October 12 committee, with marks and DPI up front. Helen also expressed interest in co-investing in Tidewater if Northwind is not taking its full allocation, and indicated Cedar Point is likely to commit to Fund III.

Alex and Chris covered household logistics: an RSVP for dinner at the Nguyens' on the 3rd and Theo's aquarium permission slip due Friday. Chris decided to move a call Dev requested for tonight to the morning, and they discussed repainting the kitchen.

In an end-of-day voice memo, Chris confirmed the Kestrel bridge wire went out at 3:00 PM. Chris noted that the Fernhill memo comments for Maya slipped to tomorrow morning, reflected on taking too many coffee meetings, and flagged a need to get up to speed on Tidewater after Helen's co-invest question.
